text:
Fleccas and Richard RatBoy host the most based, twice-weekly comedy podcast covering Western cultural decline. The podcast lampoons the political regime and reports on what we all know to be true – but few dare say. The Fleccas Talks podcast also provides two massive BonusLand hours for Pulse+ subscribers each week. Sign up today by clicking here Sign up today by clicking here.
EPISODE 276: WAR: ICE Agents Under Attack
Guys we have a very lit show for you today. In Housekeeping Biden’s White House doctor pleads the 5th when it comes to covering up his mental acuity, then we according to Kristi Noem we are entering the GOLDEN AGE because we don’t have to take our shoes off at the airport anymore. After that we are giving more money to Israel again (who could’ve guessed it), then we go over some studies about the sun and the maxine that will ring true before getting into our migrant section where ICE is under attack and LA is a ghost town. Final page is lit as well.
In Cringe of the Week we have some new disabled barbies followed by a gay pixar movie that got the axe. After that is a very vulgar trans person that says the opposite of something normal. We end cringe with a CRINGE VS URBAN DECAY SHOWDOWN.
In Urban Decay we have a JUST GIVE THEM YOUR NUMBER section followed by some horrible EBT collectors followed by a kid who tries to scam a fair worker. We end urban with a white fight at the golf course.
As always stay until the end for Uplifting Gold. All this and more it’s Fleccas Talks: The Podcast episode 271, ranked the best new podcast OF ALL TIME!!
